summary: Colin Wright, based in Cambridge, UK, has a background in mathematics and programming, with expertise in languages such as C, Python, and ARM assembler. He has a strong interest in aviation, particularly in aircraft design and technology, as evidenced by his discussions on the MC-10 Cri-Cri and other aircraft. Colin is also engaged in the tech community, frequently participating in discussions on Hacker News and contributing to projects related to programming and technology. He expresses a critical view of online anonymity and the implications of identity in digital discussions, reflecting a concern for personal safety based on past experiences. His hobbies include exploring mathematical concepts and engaging in discussions about education and the teaching of mathematics. Colin has a family structure that includes a spouse, and he values collaboration and community engagement in his professional and personal endeavors.
